title: H_1 of the naive cotangent complex of a polynomial ring vanishes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$ and $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ the polynomial ring, an $R$-algebra. Then $H_1(L_{P/R})=0$, where $H_1(L_{P/R})$ is the first homology of the naive cotangent complex $\mathrm{NL}_{P/R}$ of [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] (formed with the canonical presentation $R[P]\to P$).
